# costfluent_savings_items (Data Source)

List the findings in a workspace's savings queue, narrowed by the queue's filters. Findings are read-only here: they move through their states in Costfluent. Needs a token with `viewSavingsItems` on the workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Findings to review in the provider's workspace estimated to save at least 100 a month, largest
# first.
data "costfluent_savings_items" "to_review" {
  tab                    = "toReview"
  minimum_monthly_saving = "100"
  sort                   = "largestSaving"
}

output "largest_finding" {
  value = try(data.costfluent_savings_items.to_review.savings_items[0].title, null)
}

# Rightsizing findings one connection's provider generated, in another workspace.
data "costfluent_savings_items" "rightsizing" {
  workspace_id     = "wsp_0000000000000000000001"
  kind             = "rightsizing"
  cloud_account_id = "prv_0000000000000000000001"
}

output "rightsizing_monthly_savings" {
  value = [for item in data.costfluent_savings_items.rightsizing.savings_items : "${item.estimated_monthly_saving} ${item.currency}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cloud_account_id` (String) Only findings the provider of this connection generated. An unknown connection matches no finding.
- `kind` (String) Only findings of this kind, such as rightsizing, idle, generational, storage, commitmentPurchase, extendedSupport or other.
- `minimum_monthly_saving` (String) Only findings estimated to save at least this much each month, in each finding's own currency, as a decimal string such as "100".
- `sort` (String) The order: newest (the default) or largestSaving.
- `source` (String) Only findings from this source, such as operator, billingAnalysis or a provider's engine (awsCostOptimizationHub, azureAdvisor, gcpRecommender).
- `tab` (String) Only the findings of this tab of the queue: toReview, inProgress, verified or closed. Every status when omitted.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID. Uses the provider's workspace if not specified.

### Read-Only

- `savings_items` (Attributes List) The findings, in the order sort asks for. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--savings_items))

<a id="nestedatt--savings_items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `savings_items`

Read-Only:

- `accepted_at` (String) When the finding was accepted.
- `confidence` (String) low, medium or high.
- `cost_basis` (String) The cost the estimate and any measurement compare, such as ActualCost.
- `created_at` (String) When the finding was created.
- `currency` (String) Currency of the finding's amounts.
- `effort` (String) low, medium or high.
- `estimated_monthly_saving` (String) Estimated saving each month, in currency.
- `evidence` (String) Why the finding saves money, such as the usage it was read from.
- `id` (String) Finding ID.
- `implemented_at` (String) When the finding was marked implemented.
- `kind` (String) What a generated finding asks for; null for one an operator wrote.
- `last_measured_at` (String) When the latest measurement was made.
- `last_measurement_outcome` (String) The latest measurement's outcome: realized, partial, notRealized or inconclusive; null until one was made.
- `last_measurement_realized_monthly` (String) The monthly saving the latest measurement found, in currency.
- `last_measurement_scope` (String) The cost the latest measurement read, as CQL.
- `last_seen_at` (String) When the provider last reported a generated finding.
- `owner` (String) Who acts on the finding, as the workspace names them.
- `rejected_at` (String) When the finding was rejected.
- `rejection_reason` (String) Why the finding was rejected; null unless it was.
- `resource` (String) The provider's identifier of the resource a generated finding is about.
- `risk` (String) low, medium or high.
- `scope` (String) The cost a measurement of a generated finding reads, as CQL.
- `source` (String) Where the finding came from: operator, billingAnalysis or a provider's engine, among others.
- `status` (String) open, accepted, implemented, verified, rejected or withdrawn.
- `title` (String) What to change.
- `updated_at` (String) When the finding last changed.
- `verified_at` (String) When the finding was verified.
- `verified_monthly_saving` (String) The saving a measurement confirmed each month, in currency; null until one did.
